notes.title: System Requirements Updated
notes.notes:
Dear players,

   As a result of our optimization studies in Alpha version for a while, there have been serious performance increases. However, since Steamworks software no longer supports 32-bit systems, we had to cut 32-bit support by compelling us. As our players participating in the Alpha test have seen, we are refreshing the entire interface of the game. We are trying to design a smoother and more useful interface. If we come to changing system requirements;


Minimum System Requirements:

* Windows 7 and above 64-bit
* 512 MB RAM
* 512 MB Graphics Card


Recommended System Requirements:

* Windows 7 and above 64-bit
* 1 GB RAM
* 2 GB Graphics Card

notes.title: We are completely renewing the interface.
notes.notes: We continue our work nonstop.  The interface of the game was not very good.  So we are renewing the interface complete with new update.  At first, we only renewed the main menu.  But that's not enough.  Currently being tested on alpha.  We often publish updates on alpha channel and share them with the testers.  We do not know when the update is published to all everyone.  We will share a certain date as soon as possible.
